## Packages  
```{r message = FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo = TRUE}
library(tidyverse)
library(simr)
library(pwr)
```

## Power for t-test
```{r}
ttest_power = pwr.t.test(n = seq(10, 150, by=10), d = 0.25, sig.level = 0.05, type="paired", alternative = "greater")

ttest_power_tbl = tibble(n=ttest_power$n,
                         power = ttest_power$power)

ttest_power_tbl %>% ggplot(aes(x=n, y = power)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8) +
  ggtitle("Paired t-test")

```
## Data wrangling
Prepare data from Acon1 for two diffrent power analyses:  
1) sleep data only (about 90 items per participant)  
2) two visits per participant (about 180 per participant)

```{r}
#Load Acon1 data
load(file = "Acon1_forTMR01power_Jan21.Rda")

#Extract participant IDs
subID = unique(newRetrData$CrossProject_ID)

#Ideal nr of items to be cued, based on afc performance
n_items_wished = c(38, 26) #correct, incorrect


#For each participant, assign cued variable, so that half of the trials will be cued and other half will be not cued
newRetrData$cued = matrix(NA, nrow =dim(newRetrData)[1], ncol = 1)
newRetrData2 = newRetrData[FALSE,]
for (v in c(1, 2)) { #visit   
  for (i in unique(newRetrData$CrossProject_ID)) {
    tmpdata  = newRetrData %>% filter(newRetrData$CrossProject_ID == i & newRetrData$visit == v)
    
    if (dim(tmpdata)[1] != 0) {
      #Calculate whether wished nr of correct/incorrect AFC trials are available and modify accordingly
      n_items_available = c(sum((tmpdata$AFCaccuracy == TRUE)), sum((tmpdata$AFCaccuracy == FALSE)))
      
      if(all(n_items_available - n_items_wished >= 0)){
        n_items_available = n_items_wished
      } else if (n_items_available[1] - n_items_wished[1] < 0) {
        n_items_available = c(n_items_available[1], n_items_wished[2] + (n_items_wished[1] - n_items_available[1]))
      } else if (n_items_available[2] - n_items_wished[2] < 0) {
        n_items_available = c(n_items_wished[1] + (n_items_wished[2] - n_items_available[2]), n_items_available[2])
      }
      
      #Divide data by afc accuracy
      tmpafccorrect = tmpdata %>% filter(AFCaccuracy == TRUE)
      tmpafcincorrect = tmpdata %>% filter(AFCaccuracy == FALSE)
      
      #Assigncues
      tmpafccorrect$cued = sample(c(rep(1, n_items_available[1]), rep(0, dim(tmpafccorrect)[1]-n_items_available[1])))
      tmpafcincorrect$cued = sample(c(rep(1, n_items_available[2]), rep(0, dim(tmpafcincorrect)[1]-n_items_available[2])) )
      
      
      newRetrData2 = bind_rows(newRetrData2, tmpafccorrect, tmpafcincorrect)
    }
  }
}

#Divide data into two datasets
retrData_sleep = newRetrData2 %>% filter(consolidation_state == "SLEEP")
retrData_visit = newRetrData2
rm("tmpdata", "v", "t", "newRetrData", "newRetrData2", "tmpafccorrect", "tmpafcincorrect", "i")

#Check mean accuracies
retrData_sleep = retrData_sleep %>% group_by(CrossProject_ID) %>% 
  mutate(ntrials = length(CrossProject_ID)) %>% 
  ungroup()

retrData_sleep %>% group_by(CrossProject_ID, cued, AFCaccuracy) %>% 
  summarize(correctsource = sum(accuracy)/ntrials) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% group_by(cued, AFCaccuracy) %>% 
  summarize(correctsource = mean(correctsource, na.rm = TRUE))

#Calculate effect size in log odds-ratio based on Acon data and meta-analysis
p0 = 0.83
p1 = 0.86
logodds = log(p1/(1-p1)) - log(p0/(1-p0))

```

## Power for logistic regression (sleep data only)

```{r}
#Fit logistic regression model
retrData_sleep$CrossProject_ID = as.factor(retrData_sleep$CrossProject_ID)
retrData_sleep$AFCaccuracy = as.factor(retrData_sleep$AFCaccuracy)
retrData_sleep$cued = as.factor(retrData_sleep$cued)

mod = glmer(accuracy ~ cued + AFCaccuracy + (1|CrossProject_ID), data = retrData_sleep, family = "binomial")

#Set the predicted baseline effect and cue effect size
mod_sleep = mod
#fixef(mod_sleep)["(Intercept)"] = log(p0/(1-p0)) 
fixef(mod_sleep)["cued1"] = logodds 

#Print summary of the dummy-model
print(summary(mod_sleep))

#Extend sample size for the dummy-model
mod_sleep_extended = extend(mod_sleep, along = "CrossProject_ID", n = 100)

#Calculate power curve
powercurve_mod_sleep = powerCurve(mod_sleep_extended, along = "CrossProject_ID",
                                  test = fixed("cued1"))
print(powercurve_mod_sleep)

#Visualization of the power curve
plot(powercurve_mod_sleep)

#Save results for sleep model
save(retrData_sleep, mod_sleep, mod_sleep_extended, powercurve_mod_sleep, file = "TMR01_ResultsPower_SleepModel.RData")

```

## Power for logistic regression (two visits)

```{r}
#Fit logistic regression model
retrData_visit$CrossProject_ID = as.factor(retrData_visit$CrossProject_ID)
retrData_visit$visit = as.factor(retrData_visit$visit)
retrData_visit$AFCaccuracy = as.factor(retrData_visit$AFCaccuracy)
retrData_visit$cued = as.factor(retrData_visit$cued)

mod2 = glmer(accuracy ~ cued + AFCaccuracy + visit + (1|CrossProject_ID), data = retrData_visit, family = "binomial")

#Set the predicted baseline effect and cue effect size
mod_visit = mod2
#fixef(mod_visit)["(Intercept)"] = log(p0/(1-p0)) 
fixef(mod_visit)["cued1"] = logodds

#Print summary of the dummy-model
print(summary(mod_visit))

#Extend sample size for the dummy-model
mod_visit_extended = extend(mod_visit, along = "CrossProject_ID", n = 100)

#Calculate power curve
powercurve_mod_visit = powerCurve(mod_visit_extended, along = "CrossProject_ID", test = fixed("cued1"))
print(powercurve_mod_visit)

#Visualization of the power curve
plot(powercurve_mod_visit)

#Save results for the visit model
save(retrData_visit, mod_visit, mod_visit_extended, powercurve_mod_visit, file = "TMR01_ResultsPower_VisitModel.RData")
```
